title: Packaging Hierarchy
description: One item's each -> case -> pallet conversion hierarchy. Referenced by Topology-as-Code's replenishment_strategy.unit_conversion and OrderOrchestration-as-Code's split rules (e.g. 'only split at case boundaries').

item_id.description: References an id in this category's structure/items.yaml.

uom_hierarchy.description: Ordered smallest-to-largest. The first entry's uom must equal the item's default_uom; each subsequent entry's quantity_of_previous is how many of the prior entry's uom make up one of this entry's uom.

quantity_of_previous.description: How many of the previous entry's uom make up one of this uom. Ignored (should be 1) on the first entry.

barcodes.description: Codes printed on this packaging level (each, case, pallet), used to identify the item and its quantity on scan (myWMS ItemDataNumber per PackagingUnit). A code is unique per stock owner across the whole company - in a single-owner company simply across the company; see tools/validate.py.

type.description: gtin = GS1 GTIN-8/12/13/14, digits only, check digit verified by tools/validate.py. internal = any code assigned by the owner or warehouse.

primary.description: The code to print on labels when several exist for this packaging level. At most one per level.
